description: Type the 409 `snapshot_compacted` a snapshot download gets after the snapshot's older layers were cleaned up. The spec documents it on GET /snapshots/{snapshotId}/download ("A snapshot whose older layers were cleaned up answers 409 `snapshot_compacted`"). The operation declares only 404, so it reached callers as the generic status error. Source: spec-mirror-boat-dev 71ab00f.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The snapshot's older layers were cleaned up, so it cannot be downloaded as layers. Read its files instead.
